title: Four motors in a ramp
finding: All four motors hold 7545 to 7572 rpm at full throttle on 13 inch props; the clamp reads 89.3 A at 64 percent.
chip: OpenESC-30x30, 4 motors, 13 inch rig, clamp reference

caveats.text: That the board is an OpenESC-30x30 is the operator's statement; its revision is not in the capture.
The clamp reads no value between 8.9 s and 17.4 s: the current there is above 89 A and not measured.
The ESC's own current sense reads 318 A at full throttle; where both read it is 1.16 to 1.45 times the clamp, so that figure is not a measurement.

reduction: Logged frames, without throttle or speed transients.
